$schema_note: SC-55 parameter database, generated from the SC-55 owner's manual pp.58-86 (MIDI Implementation v1.00, Jan 1991).

device.name: Roland SC-55 Sound Canvas
device.checksum: (128 - ((sum of address bytes + data bytes [+ size bytes for RQ1]) mod 128)) mod 128

addressing.note: In addresses, replace 'n' by the block digit of the part (part 10 = 0), 'm' by the drum map (0/1), 'rr' by the drum key number.

encodings.nibblized: each byte carries 4 bits, most significant nibble first

parameters.label: GS Reset
parameters.notes: Send DT1 with data 00 to reset to GS standard mode (F0 41 10 42 12 40 00 7F 00 41 F7).

parameters.label: Partial Reserve Part 1

parameters.label: Tone Number (CC0 / Program Change)
parameters.notes: Byte 1 = CC#0 value (variation), byte 2 = program change value (instrument number - 1).

parameters.label: Mono/Poly Mode
parameters.notes: 0 = Mono, 1 = Poly.

parameters.label: Pitch Offset Fine
parameters.notes: Nibblized 2 bytes, default 08 00. Exact raw range hard to read on the scan (08..F8?).

parameters.label: System Information (ASCII)
parameters.notes: Returns "GS Standard VER=1.11" style text. RQ1 only.

parameters.label: Displayed Letters
parameters.notes: 1 to 32 bytes; scrolls automatically beyond 16 characters.

parameters.label: Displayed Dot Data
parameters.notes: 64 bytes d00-d63; bit state 1 = dot on.

bulkDump.note: Addresses read from the manual scan (p.82-83); sizes are nibblized. Check before relying on them.

instruments.note: programChange value = pc - 1. Capital tones use CC0 = 0. Variations use the listed CC0 value with the same program change.

mt32Set.note: 128 MT-32 instrument names (manual p.69) not included in this file.
